Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render

Class CubemapRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.CubemapRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
processing.core.PConstants
public class CubemapRenderer extends Object implements processing.core.PConstants
Captures a scene into a native OpenGL cubemap texture.

The renderer preserves the qualified 1.5 camera-orientation contract while using one reusable Processing OpenGL scratch target. Each rendered scratch face is copied GPU-to-GPU into the corresponding GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP face.

This avoids adapting the scene camera itself to native cubemap framebuffer conventions. Any framebuffer-origin conversion is isolated to the blit step.

    • setEquirectangularBackground

      public void setEquirectangularBackground(processing.core.PImage image)
      Sets the LDR equirectangular environment image rendered behind spherical capture.

      The library draws the environment at far depth after the scene has populated the reusable scratch target, then transfers the combined colour to the native cubemap face.

      Parameters:
      image - Processing image, or null to clear the environment
